views.definition:
SELECT ema.public_id AS match_id,
    ema.matched_entity_type,
    ema.matched_public_id,
    ema.method,
    ema.confidence,
    ema.status,
    a.source_hash AS source_hash_a,
    b.source_hash AS source_hash_b
   FROM ((cmpe.entity_match_assertion ema
     JOIN cmpe.source_record a ON ((a.source_record_id = ema.source_record_a_id)))
     JOIN cmpe.source_record b ON ((b.source_record_id = ema.source_record_b_id)));

SELECT o.public_id AS observation_id,
    o.observation_kind,
    pp.public_id AS presentation_id,
    mp.public_id AS product_id,
    f.public_id AS facility_id,
    g.public_id AS geography_id,
    g.canonical_name AS geography_name,
    d.code AS diagnosis_code,
    o.reporting_period,
    o.reporting_part,
    o.patient_count,
    o.package_count,
    o.cost_original,
    o.currency,
    o.cost_bgn,
    o.cost_eur,
    sr.source_hash,
    dr.public_id AS dataset_release_id,
    ds.public_id AS dataset_id
   FROM ((((((((cmpe.observation_result o
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.product_presentation pp ON ((pp.product_presentation_id = o.product_presentation_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.medicinal_product mp ON ((mp.medicinal_product_id = pp.medicinal_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.facility f ON ((f.facility_id = o.facility_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.geography g ON ((g.geography_id = o.geography_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.diagnosis_reference d ON ((d.diagnosis_reference_id = o.diagnosis_reference_id)))
     JOIN cmpe.source_record sr ON ((sr.source_record_id = o.source_record_id)))
     JOIN cmpe.dataset_release dr ON ((dr.dataset_release_id = sr.dataset_release_id)))
     JOIN cmpe.dataset ds ON ((ds.dataset_id = dr.dataset_id)));

SELECT pp.public_id AS presentation_id,
    mp.public_id AS product_id,
    mp.preferred_name AS product_name,
    ps.public_id AS substance_id,
    ps.preferred_name AS substance_name,
    pp.packaging,
    pp.concentration,
    pp.num_in_pack,
    ia.lexical_value AS nhif_code
   FROM ((((cmpe.product_presentation pp
     JOIN cmpe.medicinal_product mp ON ((mp.medicinal_product_id = pp.medicinal_product_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.pharmaceutical_substance ps ON ((ps.substance_id = mp.primary_substance_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.identifier_assignment ia ON (((ia.entity_type = 'product_presentation'::text) AND (ia.entity_public_id = pp.public_id))))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.identifier_scheme ids ON ((ids.identifier_scheme_id = ia.identifier_scheme_id)))
  WHERE ((ids.scheme_name = 'NHIF product code'::text) OR (ids.scheme_name IS NULL));

SELECT a.public_id AS assertion_id,
    a.subject_public_id,
    a.predicate_key,
    a.object_lexical,
    a.object_public_id,
    es.public_id AS evidence_support_id,
    sr.source_record_id,
    sr.source_hash,
    sr.row_number,
    dr.public_id AS dataset_release_id,
    ds.public_id AS dataset_id,
    ds.doi,
    tr.public_id AS transformation_run_id,
    tr.adapter_name,
    tr.adapter_version
   FROM (((((cmpe.assertion a
     JOIN cmpe.evidence_support es ON ((es.assertion_id = a.assertion_id)))
     JOIN cmpe.source_record sr ON ((sr.source_record_id = es.source_record_id)))
     JOIN cmpe.dataset_release dr ON ((dr.dataset_release_id = sr.dataset_release_id)))
     JOIN cmpe.dataset ds ON ((ds.dataset_id = dr.dataset_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cmpe.transformation_run tr ON ((tr.transformation_run_id = sr.transformation_run_id)));
